name: v2.24.18
body:
- [Update Minify.Bytes and Minify.String regarding buffer reuse](https://github.com/tdewolff/minify/commit/82c4726f5fe199f2f73537b7a410c6a9c91657ce)
- [SVG: fix and improve pathdata minification,](https://github.com/tdewolff/minify/commit/66b968c00d6fca80f1dd73a8414979e0938e8b18) [fixes](https://github.com/tdewolff/minify/commit/66b968c00d6fca80f1dd73a8414979e0938e8b18) https://github.com/tdewolff/minify/issues/1023
- [Clone external command arguments before replacing file placeholders](https://github.com/tdewolff/minify/commit/89be0510d0cfc5a7953dac3c842acc979b9f16b3)
- [Return output copy errors from external minifiers](https://github.com/tdewolff/minify/commit/8a6a90fc11dad578479d18069bff048d89d106a4)
- [SVG: undo removing first MoveTo command, it is mandatory](https://github.com/tdewolff/minify/commit/bc8705359b222873a4e8f9fec94e37103853ab4e)
- [JS: fix precendence for &&= ||= ??= operators,](https://github.com/tdewolff/minify/commit/154c18715c1409ca06df640d27c8e04f4a3f6af4) [fixes](https://github.com/tdewolff/minify/commit/154c18715c1409ca06df640d27c8e04f4a3f6af4) https://github.com/tdewolff/minify/issues/1037
- [Fix security issue GHSA-3ppm-p7r9-c5w3; properly escape </script> inside HTML script tag case-insensitively](https://github.com/tdewolff/minify/commit/f422dd349125c855452ac4940f774246726f4290)
- [Undo reuse of input byte slice in Minify.Bytes and Minify.String, it may cause problems if a minifier outputs longer output (rarely if never the case)](https://github.com/tdewolff/minify/commit/a0a31948fe6cba71f027e818321be8ccb5cfd006)
